Planets.CatText: Planets of Barnard's Star. All four confirmed planets are small rocky worlds packed into orbits of under seven days, far too close and hot to be habitable.

BarnardsStarb.Text: Barnard's Star b is a rocky planet of at least about 0.3 Earth masses with a 3.15-day orbit. Announced in 2024, it was the first planet confirmed around Barnard's Star.

BarnardsStarc.Text: Barnard's Star c is a rocky planet of at least about 0.34 Earth masses with a 4.12-day orbit, confirmed in 2025.

BarnardsStard.Text: Barnard's Star d is a rocky planet of at least about 0.26 Earth masses with a 2.34-day orbit - the innermost known planet of the system, confirmed in 2025.

BarnardsStare.Text: Barnard's Star e is the lightest known planet of the system, at least about 0.19 Earth masses, with a 6.74-day orbit. Confirmed in 2025.
